_doc: Every planner skill or vault ID this site has ever shipped (the keys of the bundle's catalog/aliases_*.json), append-only: IDs are saved in people's routines. tools/sync_bundle.py refuses a bundle in which one of these is neither an alias, a redirect nor retired by ucg-code-of-points, and adds the new bundle's IDs. tools/check_bundle.mjs and tests/published-ids.test.mjs check the vendored bundle the same way. Seeded 2026-10-20 from every aliases file in this repo's history.
